# NestEgg

> Private, offline-first budget and expense tracker. All data lives in the
> visitor's own browser (localStorage). No backend, no accounts, no telemetry.
> Free and open source (MIT).

NestEgg is a single-page PWA for tracking household income and expenses.
It opens instantly, works offline, and never sends data off-device. It is
designed for individuals, couples, and families who want a private,
zero-signup alternative to cloud-based budgeting apps.

## Core facts

- Author:  desiredsolutions.me
- Repo:    https://github.com/dnzengou/budget-tracker
- License: MIT
- Live:    https://nestegg.vercel.app/
- Stack:   React 19, Vite 7, TypeScript 5.9 (strict), Tailwind 3.4, Radix UI,
           recharts, react-router 7
- Install: zero — opens in any modern browser; installable as a PWA

## What it does

- [Dashboard](https://nestegg.vercel.app/#dashboard): income / spending /
  net / savings-rate stat tiles, 6-month trend bars, category breakdown pie.
- [Transactions](https://nestegg.vercel.app/#transactions): searchable list,
  add / edit / delete, CSV import + export (round-trip), recurring flag.
- [Budgets](https://nestegg.vercel.app/#budgets): per-category monthly caps
  with pressure insights (% of budget consumed).
- [Insights](https://nestegg.vercel.app/#insights): deterministic
  rule-engine (no LLMs) surfacing budget breaches, month-over-month swings,
  top spending levers, savings rate, and recurring-charge audits.

## Key properties

- **Offline-first.** Loads once, runs forever. No network calls after boot.
- **Private.** `localStorage['nestegg-v1']` is the only data store. The
  `auth` slice is deliberately NOT persisted so a flipped `isAdmin` flag
  in devtools does not survive reload.
- **Multi-currency.** 14 ISO 4217 codes: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD,
  CHF, CNY, INR, BRL, SEK, RWF, KES, XAF.
- **Household-aware.** One or more "members" of a nest share the same
  dataset with per-member attribution.
- **Two UX roles.** Admin (read/write) and Guest (read-only). These are
  a UI gate, not an auth boundary — the app has no server.
- **Rate-limited login.** 5 wrong passwords → 30 s in-tab cooldown.
- **Rotatable credentials.** `VITE_ADMIN_PASSWORD` / `VITE_GUEST_PASSWORD`
  are inlined at build time; defaults are `admin123` and `guest`.

## For AI agents

- Short answers: this file (`/llms.txt`).
- Long answers:  [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt).
- Install manifest: [/.well-known/ai-plugin.json](/.well-known/ai-plugin.json).
- Install UX manifest: [/manifest.webmanifest](/manifest.webmanifest).
- Site map:      [/sitemap.xml](/sitemap.xml).
- Structured data (Schema.org SoftwareApplication) is embedded as JSON-LD
  in the root `index.html` `<head>`.

Content is human-authored. We welcome ingestion by GPTBot, ClaudeBot,
Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, and other mainstream AI crawlers; see
`/robots.txt`. User data is browser-local and never served from this origin,
so there is nothing user-private to accidentally index.
